snippet.title: Yellowcreek Stories - The Cabin Watcher (Release Date Announcement)
snippet.description:
#steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4411840?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=announce&utm_medium=youtube

#playstation5 https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019627

#xbox https://www.xbox.com/es-ES/games/store/yellowcreek-stories-the-cabin-watcher/9nrf0cnvlvhc

A masked killer hunts you in the dark. Manage noise and light, hide quickly, and survive this intense first-person stealth horror experience inspired by classic 80s slasher films. 

A stormy night. A remote mountain cabin.
Someone is watching you.

A masked killer stalks the area and reacts to sound, light, and movement.
No combat. No second chances. Survival is about staying unseen, keeping calm, and making the right call under pressure.

Survive by mastering

- Noise: every action matters — loud mistakes draw attention
- Light: your flashlight can save you… or expose you
- Movement: sprinting is risky; careful steps keep you alive
- Hiding: when you’re spotted, you’re already behind

The killer actively searches based on your behavior, turning every encounter into a tense mind game.

Features

- First-person stealth slasher inspired by classic 80s horror
- Stealth built around sound, light, and movement
- Reactive enemy behavior and search patterns
- Minimal HUD with real-time noise/visibility feedback
- Interactive cinematic moments

©2026 JanduSoft & Carlos Azuaga
